record.original_question: Classify all chiral polytopes of full rank, where in Euclidean d-space this means finite d-polytopes or infinite (d+1)-polytopes.

evidence.quote: Problem 20. Describe all chiral polytopes of full rank.

artifact.self_contained_problem: An abstract polytope of rank n is called chiral if its automorphism group has exactly two orbits on the flags, with adjacent flags lying in different orbits. A geometric realization of an abstract d-polytope in Euclidean space E^N is said to be of full rank when N is the smallest dimension permitting a faithful realization; concretely, a finite chiral d-polytope is of full rank when it is realized in E^d, and an infinite chiral (d+1)-polytope is of full rank when it is realized as an apeirotope in E^d.\n\nProblem: Classify, up to similarity in Euclidean space, all chiral polytopes of full rank — that is, determine all finite chiral d-polytopes realized faithfully in E^d and all infinite chiral (d+1)-polytopes realized faithfully in E^d, for every dimension d.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work established that chiral polytopes of full rank can occur only in ranks 4 and 5: the finite rank-4 case (Roli's cube and relatives) and a chiral 5-polytope of full rank have been constructed, and the regular and chiral polytopes of full rank are reported as fully enumerated. The problem therefore appears to be solved.

status_evidence.title: Chiral polytopes of full rank exist only in ranks 4 and 5
status_evidence.snippet: Chiral polytopes of full rank exist only in ranks 4 and 5
status_evidence.claim: Restricts the ranks where chiral full-rank polytopes can exist to 4 and 5.

status_evidence.title: A chiral 5-polytope of full rank
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of a chiral 5-polytope of full rank.
status_evidence.claim: Provides an explicit chiral 5-polytope of full rank, completing the existence in rank 5.

status_evidence.title: A chiral 4-polytope in R^3
status_evidence.snippet: Roli's cube: chiral 4-polytope of full rank in E^3.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the rank-4 case of full-rank chiral polytopes.
